answer: Agent economies can resist sybils with a stake-backed vouching vault. Each newcomer locks a small refundable bond in the vault, a cheap bet on its honesty. Reward weight grows only through endorsements from established peers; endorsements travel light as a zephyr, but a fraudulent vouch costs the endorser a slice of its bond. Every validated contribution mints a compact signed sonnet of its history, so peers verify lineage and clones cannot forge it. A sybil farm must fund a bond per fake identity and risk real stakes on each endorsement, flipping the economics against attackers.
